notes: the matn after the last «ح» («قال كتب رجل إلى عمر بن عبد العزيز ...») is written once for all three branches: it is the shared tail
the asker «رجل» who writes to Umar transmits the answer, so he is an unnamed link before Umar (rule 5)
«وهذا لفظ حديث ابن كثير ومعناهم» is an editor's gloss and is left out
the first branch also writes the asker inside its own sentence; that writing is not counted again as a link
